answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybil attacks with radio time-difference-of-arrival audits. Each agent locks stake in a slashing vault and broadcasts a signed nonce that synchronized verifier stations timestamp to localize its emitter, penalizing overlapping positions. Attackers thus incur separate capital bonds and spaced radios per identity. Yet thick vine growth or a steep mesa scatters signals, skewing arrival times and causing false penalties.
